texts: good. the reservoir is linked to the named Stilllight Lantern as a part, "enough mire-essence" is recorded as a sufficient quantity, and the burning-for-one-night consequence comes through with its duration.

mixed: the building, the wraith risings, the causal "because" link and the had-risen-beforehand ordering are all captured, but two things fall short — the plural "wraiths" is recorded only as one group that rose, so nothing is derivable about any individual wraith, and "again and again" collapses into a bare "this had happened before" tag that drops the repetition. The group point is ours to fix on the translator side, not yours; the repetition only survives if you state a period or a rate, e.g. "The Council built the Stilllight Lantern because wraiths rose every year." — which pins a recurrence the original leaves vague, so use it only if the repeated-ness matters more than that vagueness.
